request: I know it's only a week out: Dallas to Phoenix on January 3rd for the small-cell build. Six of us from the crew are heading out, and I'll be on site about 16 days with my test gear. Cheapest economy please.

must_keep.quote: Requests for air travel reservations are required at least seven (7) days prior to the planned departure date. However, based on the nature of Goodman Networks' business, if these requirements cannot be met, an out of policy notification will be sent to the approving manager, who will either provide justification and approve the travel request or disapprove the request. The approving manager will make the exception to the out of policy notification and approve the travel request.
must_keep.why: requests at least seven days ahead, or the approving manager's exception

must_keep.quote: Within travel policy, the lowest logical airfare is always required.
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest logical airfare

must_keep.quote: Employees must obtain authorization for all travel prior to booking any travel arrangements.
must_keep.why: every trip needs its sign-off before booking

must_keep.quote: TABLE 2: TRAVEL APPROVAL HIERARCHY Dollar Range Approver $1 - $500 Manager Approval $501-$750 Director Approval $751 - $1,100 Vice President and/or Division General Manager Approval $1,101 + Executive Vice President / President-COO Approval $1,200 + or first class tickets Chief Executive Officer Notification
must_keep.why: Table 2: the approval each dollar range of travel expenses needs

distractors.quote: Group Meetings are defined as 10 or more people traveling to a common destination for a common purpose.
distractors.why: six travellers are not a group meeting

distractors.quote: When traveling for more than 14 days.
distractors.why: a day count for excess baggage, not for booking

distractors.quote: The employee should call a minimum of one (1) hour prior to departure time to cancel.
distractors.why: a time rule for cancelling, not for booking

design_notes: Requested on December 27 for January 3: 7 days across the month and year end, which is 'at least seven (7) days' (line 683), so no exception is needed. Six travellers are not a group meeting (10 or more, line 1209); the 14-day baggage rule and the cancellation hour do not touch the ticket. The lowest logical airfare.
